article.title: Move to a lower plan or change your billing period
article.markdown:
# Move to a lower plan or change your billing period

This article explains how to move from Max 20x to Max 5x, from Max to Pro, or from annual to monthly Pro billing. It also covers what happens to your billing, usage limits, API credits, and work when you do.

**Where you subscribed decides where you make the change.** If you subscribed on claude.ai or Claude Desktop, use Settings > Billing. If you subscribed in Claude for iOS or Claude for Android, the change happens through the App Store or Google Play.

## Move to a lower plan on the web or Claude Desktop

1. Click your initials or name in the lower left corner and select **Settings**.
2. Go to **Settings > Billing**.
3. Click **Adjust plan** next to your plan details. [CONFIRM: Is "Adjust plan" the entry point for moving down a tier? It is the button used for monthly-to-annual Pro changes.]
4. Choose your new plan (Max 5x or Pro) and confirm.

**If you don't see an option to move to a lower plan,** you can still get there in two steps:

1. Cancel your current plan in **Settings > Billing** at least 24 hours before your next billing date. You keep your current plan until the end of the billing period.
2. When the period ends, subscribe to the plan you want.

## When the change takes effect

[CONFIRM: Does a downgrade take effect immediately or at the next renewal date?]

For comparison, upgrades take effect right away: you're charged for one full cycle of the new plan, less the unused value of your old plan, and your billing cycle resets.

## What happens to your money

- **Fees:** [CONFIRM: There is no fee to move to a lower plan.]
- **Unused value:** For some mid-cycle plan changes, one cycle of the new plan costs less than the value left on your current plan. When that happens, the difference is stored as a credit on your account and applied automatically to future invoices. It isn't refunded to your card.
- **Coming back later:** If you upgrade again, you're charged for one full cycle of the higher plan, less the unused value of your current plan. There's no extra fee for upgrading.

## What happens to your usage limits

- Your usage limits match your new plan once the change takes effect. [CONFIRM: timing, as above.]
- **Use any limit reset first.** If you have an unused limit reset, it's no longer available after you downgrade.
- If you need more usage on a lower plan, you can turn on usage credits instead of moving back up.

## What happens to your monthly API credits

- **Max to Pro:** Pro isn't eligible for monthly API credits, so new credits stop. Credits you already have stay usable until they expire.
- **Max 20x to Max 5x:** [CONFIRM: Does the next monthly grant drop from $200 to $100, and is any part of the current grant reduced?]

## What happens to your chats, projects, and work

[CONFIRM: Chats, projects, Claude Code sessions, and Cowork tasks stay on your account when you move to a lower plan.]

Pro and Max both include Claude Code and Cowork, so you can keep using them on Pro with Pro's usage limits.

## Switch from annual to monthly Pro billing

[CONFIRM: Can annual Pro subscribers choose monthly billing for their next renewal in Settings > Billing?]

If there's no option for it, cancel your annual plan at least 24 hours before your renewal date, keep using Pro until the year ends, and then subscribe to monthly Pro. The Max plan is only available with monthly billing.

## If you subscribed in Claude for iOS or Claude for Android

Apple and Google manage subscriptions bought in the mobile apps.

- **iOS:** Tap your initials, then **Billing > Manage subscription**. [CONFIRM: Are Pro and Max 5x listed as options in Apple's subscription screen?]
- **Android:** Tap your initials, then **Billing > Manage subscription**. Google Play also lets you [change or pause a subscription](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481).

## Related articles

- [Cancel your Pro or Max subscription](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8325617-cancel-your-pro-or-max-subscription)
- [Understanding your Pro or Max plan invoices](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16607638-understanding-your-pro-or-max-plan-invoices)
- [Monthly API credits for Max and Team plans](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17154008-monthly-api-credits-for-max-and-team-plans)
- [What is a limit reset?](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17007452-what-is-a-limit-reset)
- [Manage usage credits for paid Claude plans](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12429409-manage-usage-credits-for-paid-claude-plans)
